how_to_run: Start a fresh agent session in a sample repo with the skill installed, send each prompt, and check every 'expect' item. should_trigger=false prompts must NOT load the skill.

cases.prompt: Add PDF export to the invoices page.
expect: every step has a file and a check
waits for go-ahead before editing (touches several files)

cases.prompt: Migrate our auth from sessions to JWT.
expect: marks auth and data steps as risky

cases.prompt: Refactor the pricing module, it's a mess.
expect: asks or states the concrete reason
keeps behaviour changes out of refactor steps

cases.prompt: Fix the typo in the README title.
expect: fixes it directly with no plan
asks at most 3 questions, each with a default
does not start coding on a guess

cases.prompt: Rename the 'Contact' nav label to 'Get in touch' in Nav.tsx.
expect: makes the change directly, no formal plan and no waiting

cases.prompt: Add a dark-mode toggle to the header (auto mode is on, just do it).
expect: writes a 3-5 line inline plan with a check per step
does not wait for a go-ahead
still stops before any risky step
